about: Alerts a person has looked at and acknowledged (pipeline/health.py, 'known'). A RED or AMBER line that reads exactly as one under 'lines', and a failed paper-options run whose own job log shows it stopped only on alerts under 'paper_options_alerts', are reported under KNOWN and do not count in the status. Any change to the line, a new alert, an unreadable log or a date past 'until' alarms as before. Every entry needs why, source, acknowledged and until. Remove an entry when its cause is gone.
